segments.en: All the days of one's life one should yearn, pray, and strive to settle in Eretz Yisroel — and at the very least to walk four cubits upon her soil. Through this one merits length of patience and the ability to ascend from level to level — and draws down upon oneself the totality of holiness. This is the essential victory of holiness for a person in this world. May Hashem Yisborach help us to walk in the ways of the true Tzaddik in truth and in faith — and to draw his light upon us and upon all Yisroel — and through this may we merit the redemption of body and soul, speedily in our days, Amen and Amen.
